item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a single 2024 document that reads like a standalone second-term manifesto for Biden. The ideology is clear in fragments and budgetary priorities, but once the campaign crisis hit, the public-facing strategic direction shifted toward anti-Trump/Project 2025 defense and managed transition rather than a clean, intact governing blueprint.","evidence":[{"title":"Address Before a Joint Session of the Congress on the State of the Union","publisher":"The American Presidency Project","date":"2024-03-07","url":"https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/address-before-joint-session-the-congress-the-state-the-union-30","summary":"Biden explicitly laid out a governing frame: freedom and democracy under assault, “middle out and bottom up” growth, a “fair shot,” no one left behind, and restoration of Roe. That is a clear ideology/program, not just ad hoc rhetoric.","question_ids":["8B.1"]},{"title":"FACT SHEET: The President's Budget Lowers Costs for the American People","publisher":"The American Presidency Project","date":"2024-03-11","url":"https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/fact-sheet-the-presidents-budget-lowers-costs-for-the-american-people","summary":"The budget translates the ideology into a policy agenda: lower costs, treat health care as a right, expand child care, housing, college access, broadband, and make wealthy corporations pay their fair share. This is a concrete second-term program.","question_ids":["8B.1"]},{"title":"Remarks by National Economic Advisor Lael Brainard on Lowering Costs for American Consumers","publisher":"The American Presidency Project","date":"2024-06-20","url":"https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/remarks-national-economic-advisor-lael-brainard-lowering-costs-american-consumers","summary":"Biden’s top domestic priority is stated plainly as lowering costs for middle-class families, using government tools to cut prices in essential household categories. That is strategic direction that can be checked against later policy.","question_ids":["8B.1"]},{"title":"Memorial Day remarks: “Every generation has to earn it”","publisher":"Associated Press","date":"2024-05-27","url":"https://www.ap.org/news-highlights/elections/2024/biden-says-each-generation-has-to-earn-freedom-in-solemn-memorial-day-remarks/","summary":"Biden described the governing moral conflict as “autocracy vs democracy” and “the greed of a few” vs “the rights of many,” then tied that to freedom, opportunity, and equality. This is a highly legible governing ideology.","question_ids":["8B.1"]},{"title":"2024 Democratic Party Platform","publisher":"The American Presidency Project","date":"2024-08-18","url":"https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/2024-democratic-party-platform","summary":"The platform shows continuity around Biden’s agenda after he stepped aside: protect Social Security/Medicare, keep Medicare drug-price reforms, oppose special-interest giveaways, and advance middle-class relief. It is useful as the revealed governing program attached to his coalition.","question_ids":["8B.1"]},{"title":"How Project 2025’s rightward vision became a flashpoint in this year’s election","publisher":"Associated Press","date":"2024-08-21","url":"https://www.ap.org/news-highlights/elections/2024/how-project-2025s-rightward-vision-became-a-flashpoint-in-this-years-election/","summary":"Biden’s campaign used Project 2025 as a shorthand warning about Trump’s second term, which reveals a clear strategic goal: frame the election as a defense of democracy against an authoritarian/right-wing program. That is explicit, but it is also more oppositional than a full positive governing blueprint.","question_ids":["8B.1"]},{"title":"Biden drops out of 2024 race after disastrous debate inflamed age concerns. VP Harris gets his nod","publisher":"Associated Press","date":"2024-07-21","url":"https://www.ap.org/news-highlights/elections/2024/biden-drops-out-of-2024-race-after-disastrous-debate-inflamed-age-concerns-vp-harris-gets-his-nod/","summary":"The reelection effort lost coherence after the debate; Biden said he would finish the term, then stepped aside and endorsed Harris, with Democrats suddenly needing to “bring coherence” to the nomination fight. This weakens the case for a stable, fully articulated second-term governing program in the back half of 2024.","question_ids":["8B.1","7B.8"]}]}
